ticket: I was charged twice for my subscription this month. I need a refund for the duplicate charge.
final_response:
Dear customer,

I apologize for the inconvenience of being charged twice for your subscription this month. We are reviewing your account to verify the duplicate charge and will issue a full refund for the extra transaction. Duplicate charges are typically resolved within 3-5 business days.

Thank you for your patience.

ticket: How do I export my data to CSV? I can't find the option anywhere in the settings.
final_response: I understand you're looking to export your data to CSV. You can find this option by navigating to **Settings → Data → Export**, then selecting your desired format and clicking 'Download'. Please note that for large datasets, exports are generated asynchronously and will be emailed to you when ready.

# Technical Support Guide ## Data Export
To export data to CSV: go to Settings → Data → Export → Select format → Download. Exports are generated asynchronously and emailed when ready for large datasets. CSV exports include all records from the selected date range. ## Login Issues

API keys are generated in Settings → Developer → API Keys.

An account is suspended after two failed attempts, with your data retained for 30 days. final_response: When you upgrade your plan mid-month, the upgrade takes effect immediately. Prorated credits are applied automatically when upgrading mid-cycle, so you will only be charged for the new plan from the date of the upgrade. Your next invoice will reflect these adjustments.
